about: Rev3.0 glass-front fit assembly, revision GF-2.0 (stage 4), written complete by Design Reports/Rev3.0/tools/glassfront/fusion/build_gf20_reports.py; the GF-1.1 report is in Mechanical/Rev3.0_GlassFront/archive/GF-1.1/
master_revision: GF-2.0 (2026-11-16: equal 18.5 border on all four sides, FPC tails bent back at the panel edge behind a bridge, S8 dropped (S4 / R4 only); concept Design Reports/Rev3.0/tools/glassfront/concept/concept_gf2.md; see change_log)

variants.S4: visible default (4 weld studs + washers + nyloc nuts, VHB strips, sheet without holes)
variants.R4: hidden component 'Rivets R4 F1-F4 (hidden)' + hidden body 'Oven sheet R4 (rivet holes)'
variants.S8: REMOVED at GF-2.0 (components 'Weld studs S8 F5-F8 (hidden)' and 'Washers, nuts, spacers S8 F5-F8 (hidden)' deleted by script 66; there was no gasket body); socket checks F5-F8 deleted

how_driven: every part body is a user-parameter driven feature (unchanged from GF-1.1 scripts 35 / 36): the border change moved glass, print, logo zone (15 high), bond, bead (+ pip holes), tape strips, sheet cut-out, studs, washers, rivets automatically

tails.route: tail_route.<TFT|CTP>.centreline_yZ of concept_gf2_params.json (= params tail_route), 0.30 thick
tails.outline_check: x extents of the DS1 tail bodies measured along both legs (diag_gf20_old_tail_widths): TFT 84.02-122.62 to y 126.0 (v 7), 84.02-165.90 beyond, return leg 145.40-165.90; CTP 40.72-75.82 to y 128.5 (v 9.5), 50.92-70.62, return leg 58.27-61.77 below y 127.5 (v 34)
tails.old_tails: DS1 bodies tft_tail_5, tft_fingers_6, ctp_tail_7, ctp_fingers_8 hidden and renamed 'GF-1.1 reference - ... (old flat route, hidden)'; not in the assembly STEP

1_interference_frame_vs_every_body.verdict: 0 mm3 overlap between the frame and every assembly body (designed contacts at 0.0 distance: Formex on the shelf, bead on the land, VHB strips on the flange, sheet on the seat ring / pads, washers on the tube tops); frame to PCB 0.08 (board_dz artefact as GF-1.1)

2_part_pairs.note: S4 / R4 pairs overlap by construction (two variants of the same fastener positions)

g2_glass_edge_to_lip.note: ray from the nominal glass edge (rounded rectangle glass_*, R_glass) outward to the first frame material, at the side midpoints and the 45 deg corner points; Z = flush plane, the two arris ends, mid, glass back (the recess narrows 1 deg to the back)

g1_cutout_to_lip.note: ray from the nominal sheet cut-out edge (glass + s_cut, R_cut) inward to the lip outer face, at the flush plane, mid sheet and 0.25 above the sheet back (above the R0.2 lip-root fillet)

5_tails.connector_note: the tail ends lie inside the J10 / J11 housings (insertion 4.0 / 3.0; the KiCad connector models are solid): the overlaps with housing_0 / actuator_1 are the insertion, not a fit issue
